title: Ilali eselunxwemeni lwetyala
intro: Uzifumana ukwilali eselunxwemeni, apho isandi samaza sixubana nokuhleba kwabantu abalibeleyo. Banikwa umyalelo wokuphumla, kodwa ukubawa kwabo kwakhokelela kwisohlwayo esisathethwa ngaso ngelizwi eliphantsi. Ungabatyhila ukuba bangoobani?
clues: Sasihlala ngaselunxwemeni kwaye sanikwa umyalelo wokuba sigcine usuku lokuphumla.
Ngaloo mini, iintlanzi zazisiza kuthi zininzi, kodwa sasingavumelekanga ukuzithatha.
Abanye phakathi kwethu balumkisa ngokungathobeli umthetho, kodwa abanye baceba ukuloba nangona kunjalo.
Siphule umyalelo ongcwele saza sazisela isohlwayo esiqatha.
Isohlwayo sethu sasingutshintsho olusishiye singonakali kwaye sihlazekile.
Saguqulwa saba ziinkawu, umqondiso kubo bonke abaza kulandela.
arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
